sekcje: Drug Levels and Effects > Summary of Use during Lactation

No information is available on the clinical use of fulvestrant during breastfeeding. However, because of its potential toxicity in the breastfed infant and its half-life of 40 days, the manufacturer recommends that breastfeeding be discontinued during fulvestrant therapy and for 1 year after the last dose.
